title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 2, PYQ) - QA - Mixtures and Alligations
subject: QA

questions.q: A mixture of coffee and cocoa, $16\%$ of which is coffee, costs Rs $240$ per kg. Another mixture of coffee and cocoa, of which $36\%$ is coffee, costs Rs $320$ per kg. If a new mixture of coffee and cocoa costs Rs $376$ per kg, then the quantity, in kg, of coffee in $10\text{ kg}$ of this new mixture is
questions.explain:
Let $C$ and $K$ be the prices per kg of coffee and cocoa respectively.
From the given data:
$0.16C + 0.84K = 240$ $\implies$ $4C + 21K = 6000$ (Eq 1)
$0.36C + 0.64K = 320$ $\implies$ $9C + 16K = 8000$ (Eq 2)
Solving these linear equations yields $K = 176$ and $C = 576$.
For a mixture costing Rs 376 per kg, let $x$ be the proportion of coffee:
$576x + 176(1-x) = 376 \implies 400x = 200 \implies x = 0.5$.
The mixture is exactly $50\%$ coffee, so in $10\text{ kg}$, there are $5\text{ kg}$ of coffee.
